_comment: Frames of the store screenshots, rendered by render.py. 'capture' says what the raw capture must show (own demo people only; status bar 9:41); 'theme' is the theme of that capture and of the frame ground.

frames.name: air
frames.capture: Air, light theme: the you block and the network line, a request card, Online now with a group row ('4 online') and two people, Offline with 'In transit' on one row, Just for you with Saved Messages; the In transit pill shows its count

en-US.title: Who you can reach, at a glance
en-US.subtitle: People, groups and requests in one list, sorted by who is online now

ru.title: Сразу видно, кто на связи
ru.subtitle: Люди, группы и запросы в одном списке: кто в сети сейчас, видно сразу

ar-SA.title: من يمكنك الوصول إليه، بنظرة واحدة
ar-SA.subtitle: الأشخاص والمجموعات والطلبات في قائمة واحدة، مرتبة حسب من هو متصل الآن

frames.name: conversation
frames.capture: A one-to-one conversation, light theme: the time column, delivered messages, the In transit tray with one message waiting for the person who is offline, the composer with its delivery hint

en-US.title: See what has left
en-US.subtitle: A message for someone offline waits in transit and goes out by itself when they are back

ru.title: Видно, что ушло
ru.subtitle: Сообщение для того, кто не в сети, ждёт в пути и уходит само, как только собеседник вернётся

ar-SA.title: اعرف ما الذي أُرسل
ar-SA.subtitle: الرسالة لمن هو غير متصل تنتظر في الطريق، وتُرسل تلقائيًا فور عودته

frames.name: new-contact
frames.capture: New contact, light theme: a whole valid ID in groups of four, the ruler with key 64, antispam 8 and check 4 all passed, the greeting, Send request enabled on the bar above the keyboard

en-US.title: Add people by ID or QR code
en-US.subtitle: Khandaq checks the ID before your request goes out, so a typo shows up right away

ru.title: Добавляйте по ID или QR-коду
ru.subtitle: Khandaq проверяет ID до отправки запроса, так что опечатка видна сразу

ar-SA.title: أضف جهات الاتصال بالمعرّف أو رمز QR
ar-SA.subtitle: يتحقق خندق من المعرّف قبل إرسال طلبك، فيظهر الخطأ المطبعي فورًا

frames.name: group
frames.capture: A group conversation, light theme: the header '9 members, 4 online now', the Get it now strip, authors named over their runs with a moderator role, the hint under the field '4 of 8 get it now, the rest when they come online'

en-US.title: Groups that show who is there
en-US.subtitle: See who is online and who gets your message now, before you send it

ru.title: В группе видно, кто на месте
ru.subtitle: Кто в сети и кто получит сообщение сейчас, видно ещё до отправки

ar-SA.title: مجموعات تُظهر من الحاضر
ar-SA.subtitle: ترى من المتصل ومن سيستلم رسالتك الآن قبل أن ترسلها

frames.name: you
frames.capture: You, DARK theme: the QR card of your ID on its white card, Share ID and Copy ID, your name and status, the ID in its three parts

en-US.title: Your key is your account
en-US.subtitle: No phone number, no email, no account on a server: the key is made on your iPhone

ar-SA.subtitle: بلا رقم هاتف ولا بريد إلكتروني ولا حساب على خادم: يُنشأ المفتاح على جهاز iPhone الخاص بك
